fields.statement: At 22bf687 (the fix commit after review), go test ./internal/api -run 'TestParseTrailerLog|LeafCommit|ReviewCommit' -count=1 -v passes. In TestParseTrailerLog, case ddd reads Change: CS4, Actor: a, Leaf: split and Review: R1 from a paragraph followed by a separate Co-Authored-By paragraph. Case eee reads Change: CS5 and Leaf: one when they share the final paragraph with Co-Authored-By, and case aaa reads Change:, Actor: and Leaf: from a single final paragraph. Actor: and Review: are not exercised in the shared-paragraph shape, but the same line loop reads all four keys. Reading the diff: parseTrailerLog now reads only the trailing run of whole trailer paragraphs (trailerRun and trailerParagraph). Prose lines (ggg, hhh) and a squash merge's earlier commits' trailers (iii) are not read, and folded values are unfolded (jjj). That answers the review's major finding: rhiza check built from 22bf687 (RHIZA_ROOT, RHIZA_CHANGE and RHIZA_RUN unset) prints 0 evidence-actor warnings, against the 202 the review reported. go vet ./... and gofmt -l are clean, and go test ./... passes in every package.
